_meta.description: Canonical dictionary of all Warhammer 40K 10th edition keywords. Three keyword classes: ABILITY_KEYWORDS (printed in CAPS on datasheets, have rules text), FACTION_KEYWORDS (determine army membership and rule eligibility), and WEAPON_ABILITIES (printed on weapon profiles, modify attack sequence). Each entry lists the defining rule_id, which rule file contains the full text, and contextual metadata. math_relevant (true/conditional/false) and math_handler fields added to weapon_ability entries to bridge keyword_dictionary.json and the 11_math_terminal keyword engine.

ADVANCE.description: Unit moves up to M+D6". Cannot shoot or charge unless modified.

AIRCRAFT.description: Unit type with special movement and targeting rules. Can Fall Back and still shoot. Has minimum and maximum move distances.

ANTI.description: ANTI-[keyword] X+: Unmodified wound rolls of X+ become Critical Wounds against targets with the specified keyword.
ANTI.parameter_description: keyword (e.g. INFANTRY, VEHICLE, CHAOS) and threshold (e.g. 4+, 5+)
ANTI.math_effect_note: Unmodified wound roll of X+ always wounds target with matching keyword. Modifies wound step.

AP.description: Armour Penetration. Subtracted from target's saving throw roll. AP-0 has no effect. AP-1 means target saves on Sv+1.
AP.math_effect_note: Weapon stat (not a keyword modifier). Handled as part of the weapon profile, not via keyword handler.

ASSAULT.description: Can shoot even after Advancing. Subtract 1 from hit rolls if the unit Advanced.
ASSAULT.math_effect_note: Allows shooting after Advancing. The -1 to hit for Advancing is resolved at the pipeline level, not this keyword.

BATTLE-SHOCKED.description: Status condition applied after a failed Battle Shock test. Cannot use Stratagems. OC reduced by 1.

BLAST.description: Minimum 3 attacks vs 6+ models. Minimum 6 attacks vs 11+ models. Cannot shoot into combat.
BLAST.math_effect_note: Minimum attacks = model count when target has 6+ models. Modifies attack step.

CHARACTER.description: Unit type. Characters can be Leaders (attach to Bodyguard units), use Epic Challenge stratagem, and perform Heroic Interventions.

COVER.description: Grants +1 to saving throws against ranged attacks. Does not apply against AP-0 weapons in some editions.

CP.description: Command Points. Resource spent to use Stratagems. Gain 1 per Command phase.

D.description: Damage characteristic. Can be a fixed value (e.g. 2) or a dice value (e.g. D3, D6, 2D6).
D.math_effect_note: Weapon damage stat — part of weapon profile, not a keyword.

DAMAGED.description: Indicates the unit has a degraded stat profile at lower wound thresholds.

DEEP STRIKE.description: Unit can be held in Reserves and arrive anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from enemy models, from turn 2 onward.

DEVASTATING WOUNDS.description: Critical Wounds bypass saves and FNP. Damage is applied directly as mortal wounds.
DEVASTATING WOUNDS.math_effect_note: Critical wound rolls deal mortal wounds, bypassing saves. Modifies save step.

FALL BACK.description: Units in Engagement Range can move away. Cannot shoot or charge afterward unless modified.

FEEL NO PAIN.description: FEEL NO PAIN X+: Roll D6 per wound lost. On X+, wound is not lost.

FIGHTS FIRST.description: Unit fights before other eligible units in the Fight phase.

FIGHTS LAST.description: Unit fights after all other eligible units in the Fight phase.

FLY.description: Unit can move over models and terrain features.

HEAVY.description: Add 1 to hit rolls if the bearer did not move this turn (Remained Stationary).
HEAVY.math_effect_note: Conditional: +1 to hit if unit Remained Stationary. Activate via --remained-stationary CLI flag.

HEROIC INTERVENTION.description: CHARACTER within 6" of a charging enemy can move 3" to engage them after charges are declared.

INDIRECT FIRE.description: Can target non-visible units. Hit roll is always 4+. Target gets +1 to saving throws.
INDIRECT FIRE.math_effect_note: -1 to hit rolls when firing indirectly. Applied unconditionally by handler.

INFILTRATORS.description: Unit deploys anywhere more than 9" from enemy deployment zone and all enemy units.

INVULNERABLE SAVE.description: Saving throw not modified by AP. Used instead of, not in addition to, the armour save.

LANCE.description: Add 1 to wound rolls if the bearer charged, was charged, or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn.
LANCE.math_effect_note: Conditional: AP improved by 1 if attacker Charged this turn. Activate via --charged CLI flag.

LD.description: Leadership characteristic. Roll 2D6 vs Ld on Battle Shock tests.

LEADER.description: CHARACTER can attach to a compatible Bodyguard unit, granting special abilities and merging profiles.

LETHAL HITS.description: Critical Hits automatically wound — no wound roll required.
LETHAL HITS.math_effect_note: Critical hit rolls auto-wound, bypassing wound roll. Modifies wound step.

LONE OPERATIVE.description: Cannot be targeted by ranged attacks from more than 12" away, unless the unit is attached to another unit.

MELTA.description: MELTA X: Add X to Damage if the target is within half range.
MELTA.math_effect_note: Conditional: +N damage per unsaved wound at half range. Activate via --half-range CLI flag.

MOVE.description: Move characteristic (M) — the distance in inches a unit can move in its Movement phase.

OC.description: Objective Control value. Summed across models within range of an objective to determine control.

OUTFLANK.description: Unit arrives from a non-deployment-zone battlefield edge, more than 9" from enemies.

OVERWATCH.description: Shoot at a charging enemy unit on 6+ to hit before the charge resolves.

PISTOL.description: Can be fired even while in Engagement Range, targeting the nearest enemy unit.
PISTOL.math_effect_note: Targeting/engagement rule only. No dice math effect.

PRECISION.description: Critical Hits can be allocated to a CHARACTER model in the target unit.
PRECISION.math_effect_note: Targeting rule only — allows allocating critical hits to Characters. No dice math effect.

RAPID FIRE.description: RAPID FIRE X: Add X additional attacks if target is within half range.
RAPID FIRE.math_effect_note: Conditional: +N attacks per model at half range. Activate via --half-range CLI flag.

SCOUTS.description: SCOUTS X: Unit makes a Normal Move of up to X" after deployment but before battle round 1.

SMOKE.description: Once per game: when targeted, force attackers to hit on 6+ until start of next turn.

STEALTH.description: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for ranged attacks targeting this unit.

STRATAGEM.description: A special action purchased with CP. The STRATAGEM keyword appears on any rule that is activated by spending CP.

SUSTAINED HITS.description: SUSTAINED HITS X: Each Critical Hit generates X additional hit rolls.
SUSTAINED HITS.parameter_description: extra hits per critical hit (e.g. 1, 2, D3)
SUSTAINED HITS.math_effect_note: Critical hit rolls generate N additional hits. Modifies hit step.

TELEPORT STRIKE.description: Functionally similar to DEEP STRIKE. May have faction-specific variations allowing turn-1 arrival.

TORRENT.description: Attacks automatically hit — no hit roll required.
TORRENT.math_effect_note: All attacks auto-hit; hit roll is skipped entirely. Modifies hit step.

TRANSPORT.description: Unit that can carry other units. Has a Transport Capacity stat on its datasheet.

TWIN-LINKED.math_effect_note: Re-roll all failed hit rolls. Modifies hit step.

INFANTRY.description: Core unit type. Eligible for Go to Ground stratagem. Most numerous unit type in the game.

VEHICLE.description: Unit type. Eligible for Smokescreen stratagem and Tank Shock. Often has Damaged profiles.

MONSTER.description: Unit type. Eligible for Smokescreen stratagem. Often has Damaged profiles.

CAVALRY.description: Unit type with generally high movement values. Interacts with specific faction rules and enhancements.

DAEMON.description: Faction keyword shared across Chaos Daemons, Chaos Space Marines, Thousand Sons, Death Guard, and World Eaters units with daemonic nature.

IMPERIUM.description: Top-level faction keyword covering all Imperial armies: Space Marines, Astra Militarum, Adeptus Mechanicus, Adepta Sororitas, etc.

CHAOS.description: Top-level faction keyword covering Chaos Space Marines, Daemons, Death Guard, Thousand Sons, World Eaters, and Chaos Knights.

TYRANIDS.description: Faction keyword for the Tyranid Hive Mind. Governs Synapse range and Shadow in the Warp.

TAU EMPIRE.description: Faction keyword for the T'au Empire army. Governs For the Greater Good army rule.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES.description: Mid-level faction keyword shared by all Space Marine chapters. Sub-keywords specify the chapter.

AELDARI.description: Faction keyword for the Aeldari army. Governs Battle Focus army rule.

NECRONS.description: Faction keyword for the Necron dynasties. Governs Reanimation Protocols army rule.

ORKS.description: Faction keyword for the Orks waagh. Governs Waaagh! army rule.

COMMAND PHASE.description: Phase keyword — indicates an ability triggers 'at the start of your Command phase' or 'during the Command phase'.

STRATEGIC RESERVES.description: Units placed in Strategic Reserves during deployment for 1–2 CP. Arrive from any battlefield edge from turn 2.

BATTLELINE.description: Core unit type. Battleline units form the backbone of an army; many Detachments grant them bonuses, and some armies may take extra Battleline units beyond the normal limit.

TITANIC.description: Unit type for the largest models. Titanic units can Fall Back and still shoot and charge, and are eligible targets for certain anti-Titanic abilities.

BEAST.description: Unit type. Beasts move and act like Infantry (move through terrain freely) but are not affected by Infantry-only rules.

FORTIFICATION.description: Unit type for emplaced buildings and defences. Fortifications cannot move and have special deployment and objective-control rules.

DEDICATED TRANSPORT.description: Unit type. A Dedicated Transport is taken alongside another unit, can carry models, and does not consume a normal slot in the same way.

EPIC HERO.description: Unit type for unique named characters. Only one of each Epic Hero may be included in an army, and they usually cannot be given Enhancements.
